facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.build_fastgen_model: build a FastGen instance from a Llama checkpoint directory with model args and device
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.run_generate_all: run inference on a list of tokenized prompts and return generated token sequences with stats
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.run_main_cli: run the Llama inference CLI with a checkpoint directory and optional interactive mode
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.test_get_prompts: test the get_prompts function to yield prompts in interactive or default mode
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.review_fastgen_generate: review the FastGen.generate_all method and its CUDA graph warmup and replay logic

facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.build_llama_transformer_model: build a distributed Llama inference model with multi-process attention and feed-forward transformer blocks
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.create_function_make_cache: create a KV cache for transformer layers with configurable length, device, dtype, and layer count
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.test_Transformer_forward: test the Transformer forward pass with token values, sequence lengths, start positions, and KV cache
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.refactor_Attention_load_hook: refactor the Attention module load hook to fuse wq, wk, wv weights from vanilla Llama checkpoints
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.summarize_cache_prefix: summarize the cache_prefix function that takes a prefix view of a larger KV cache for smaller batch sizes

facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.initialize_model_parallelism: initialize model parallelism with world size, local rank, GPU device, and random seed
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.get_world_size: get the world size of the initialized model parallel process group
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.get_rank: get the local rank of the current process in the model parallel group
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.all_gather_tensors: all-gather tensors across all model parallel processes and concatenate along the last dimension
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.all_reduce_tensors: all-reduce tensors across all model parallel processes using sum reduction

facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.sample_top_p: sample top-p (nucleus) tokens from a probability distribution tensor given a threshold
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.filter_top_p_tokens: filter a probability distribution to keep only tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds a threshold
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.renormalize_top_p_distribution: renormalize a probability distribution after masking out low-probability tokens in top-p sampling
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.sort_and_cumsum_probs: sort probability values in descending order and compute their cumulative sum for nucleus sampling
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.gather_next_token: sample and gather the next token index from a filtered top-p probability distribution

facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.create_stats_instance: create a Stats instance to track generation phases and token throughput
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.build_phase_stats: build a PhaseStats dataclass with name, token count, and elapsed time
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.test_phase_method: test the Stats.phase method to start a named generation phase with token count
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.summarize_end_phase: summarize the Stats.end_phase method to terminate a phase and record stats
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.review_phase_stats_show: review the PhaseStats.show method to display tokens, time, and throughput

facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.create_tokenizer: create a Tokenizer instance from a SentencePiece model file path
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.encode_text: encode a string into a list of token IDs with optional bos and eos tokens
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.decode_tokens: decode a list of token IDs back into a human-readable string
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.test_tokenizer_roundtrip: test the Tokenizer encode and decode methods for roundtrip fidelity
facebookresearch_xformers/examples/llama.review_tokenizer_methods: review the Tokenizer class encode and decode methods for correctness
